output.one_liner: CRM platform for managing contacts, companies, leads, opportunities, projects, tasks, activities, files, and webhooks, optimized for Google Workspace.

auth.notes: API keys require admin generation in Copper web app. OAuth2 uses Authorization Code Grant flow with Bearer token authentication.

evidence.snippet: There are two ways to access the Copper Developer API: API keys and OAuth2.0.
The Dev API uses token based authentication. You have to include the token in the header of every request
Third-party integrations may take advantage of OAuth 2.0 for the purpose of authorizing and authenticating access to the Copper Developer API.

access.notes: Developer API is only available on Professional tier ($69+/user/month) or higher paid plans. Self-serve purchase required. Admin must generate API keys in-app.

evidence.snippet: Professional Tier includes all features of the Basic Tier plus the following additions
Only Admin users are able to generate API Keys.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: 180 requests per minute globally; bulk APIs limited to 3 requests per second

evidence.snippet: The Copper Developer API provides a RESTful interface with JSON-formatted responses to access most Copper resources.
All API calls are limited to 180 requests per minute. Our bulk APIs have an additional rate limit of 3 requests per second.
Webhooks allow systems integrated with Copper to receive near real-time notification of certain events
Copper is launching an official MCP server, built and hosted by Copper. The beta launches in November 2026.
MCP server for the Copper CRM

buildability.rationale: Well-documented REST API with broad resource coverage and webhooks, but requires paid Professional tier ($69+/user/month) for access and admin-only API key generation.

overview_evidence.snippet: Copper is a customer relationship management platform for managing contacts, companies, leads, opportunities, projects, tasks, activities, files, and webhooks.
The Copper Developer API provides a RESTful interface with JSON-formatted responses to access most Copper resources.
